from collections import Counter

def get_global_scores(grid):
    rows=[[(c,row[c]) for c in range(3,len(row)) if row[c]!=0] for r,row in enumerate(grid) if r>=3]
    totals=[]
    for p in range(1,11):
        sc=n=0
        for known in rows:
            if not known: continue
            buckets=[[] for _ in range(p)]
            for c,v in known:buckets[c%p].append(v)
            sc+=sum(max(Counter(b).values()) for b in buckets if b)
            n+=len(known)
        totals.append((p,sc/n))
    return totals
print('demo1',get_global_scores(demo))
